audit_items.proof_trace: All Supabase queries across every API handler use the @supabase/supabase-js builder API exclusively (.from().eq().in().insert() etc.), which transmits user-supplied values as discrete HTTP parameters or JSON body to PostgREST — never as string-concatenated SQL. Grep over the entire src/ directory confirmed zero .rpc() calls and zero template literals used in query construction; all template literals found are for logging messages or Discord nickname strings only.
